priorityList: Maintain Virulent Plague using Outbreak if it has fewer than 3 ticks remaining or is about to expire.
Cast Army of the Dead if available, ideally when you have at least 30 Runic Power or the Festering Scythe debuff is active.
Cast Dark Transformation if Army of the Dead is active or if Army of the Dead has more than 30 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Cast Death and Decay if it is not currently active on the ground.
Cast Festering Strike if you have the Festering Scythe talent and the buff or debuff is about to expire (within 3 seconds).
Use Soul Reaper on targets below 35% health.
Cast Scourge Strike whenever you have 1 or more stacks of the Lesser Ghoul Ready buff to summon a Horseman.
Cast Festering Strike if you have 0 stacks of the Lesser Ghoul Ready buff to generate resources.
Cast Putrefy if it is at max charges or if Dark Transformation is on cooldown for more than 15 seconds.
Spend Runic Power on Epidemic if you have a Sudden Doom proc, have fewer than 2 Runes, or if the Forbidden Knowledge buff is active.
Use Epidemic as your primary Runic Power spender for 4 or more targets.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racial abilities (like Blood Fury or Berserking) while Dark Transformation or Horsemen are active.
Invoke Power Infusion when Horsemen, Dark Transformation, or Forbidden Knowledge are active.
Use Death Coil only as a secondary filler if Epidemic is not the priority (less than 4 targets).
